# What will authentication cost at your user count, and who is cheapest?

> Enter your monthly active users and see what Clerk, Auth0, AWS Cognito, Firebase, Supabase Auth and WorkOS charge, the 12-month spend under your growth rate, and the user count where the cheapest provider changes. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [How to choose an auth provider by monthly active users](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/auth-mau-pricing-calculator/how-to-choose-an-auth-provider-by-mau.html)
